origin.description: Known levels stay in the given order. Anything else is missing.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Known levels stay in the given order. Anything else is missing.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- parse_factor(c("red", "blue", "green"), levels = c("blue", "red"))
paste(flatv(as.character(parsed)), paste(levels(parsed), collapse = "/"), sep = ";")
